text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is approaching, and

Matikanefukukitaru's worries over her
first
long-distance race begin to mount.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Concerned for her, Сайленс Судзука offers
some
words of encouragement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In her eyes, Матиканэфукукитару is a lot
more
amazing than she believes. Suzuka
tells her to
have a bit more confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gaining courage from those words,

Matikanefukukitaru vows to focus on the
Kikuka
Sho with a new, positive mindset.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
